app.name: Connect
app.title: {page} · Connect
language.label: Language
theme.label: Theme
auth.brand.label: About Connect
auth.brand.picture: A magnet pulls people toward it. On the way they turn into sales.
auth.brand.statement: Turn your content into a sales magnet.
auth.brand.point1: See which posts pull in visits, leads and paid sales.
auth.brand.point2: Put your time and budget where the sales come from.
auth.brand.note: Read-only connections. Connect never posts or charges.
agreement.label: I agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
agreement.required: Tick the box to agree before you continue.
field.error.email: Enter a complete address, such as name@agency.com.
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Welcome back. Use your work email.
signIn.error.credentials: The email or password is not correct.
signIn.error.unverified: Confirm your email before you sign in.
signIn.verifyLink: Enter the code we sent you
signIn.notice.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again.
signIn.notice.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.
signIn.notice.reset: Your new password is saved. Sign in with it.
signIn.notice.verified: Your email is confirmed. You can sign in now.
register.title: Create your account
register.lead: You will confirm your email with a six-digit code.
register.name: Your name
register.passwordHint: At least 15 characters. A sentence you can remember works well.
verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.lead: Enter the six-digit code we sent to {email}. It is valid for ten minutes.
verify.leadNoEmail: Enter your email and the six-digit code we sent you. The code is valid for ten minutes.
verify.resent: If this address is waiting to be confirmed, a new code is on its way.
verify.resendWait: You can ask for a new code in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
verify.error.code: That code is not correct or has expired. Check it, or ask for a new one.
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter your email. If an account uses it, we send a link that is valid for 30 minutes.
forgot.sent.title: Check your email
forgot.sent.text: If an account uses {email}, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for 30 minutes.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: Saving a new password ends every session of your account.
reset.missing.title: This link cannot be used
reset.missing.text: Open the link from the newest reset email, or ask for a new one.
reset.error.token: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
invitation.title: Join the agency
invitation.lead: You were invited to an agency on Connect.
invitation.signInFirst: Sign in with the email that received the invitation, then accept it.
invitation.missing.title: This invitation link cannot be used
invitation.missing.text: Open the link from the invitation email again. If it has expired, ask the agency to invite you once more.
invitation.error.token: This invitation has expired, was withdrawn or belongs to another email.
invitation.error.unverified: Confirm your email before you accept the invitation.
google.failed.title: Google sign-in did not finish
google.error.google_link_required: An account already uses this email. Sign in with your password, then link Google from your account page.
google.error.google_email_not_verified: Google has not confirmed this email address. Use another Google account, or sign in with a password.
google.error.google_identity_in_use: This Google account is already linked to another Connect account.
google.error.google_already_linked: Your account is already linked to a Google account.
google.error.other: Sign-in with Google did not work. Try again, or sign in with your password.
welcome.title: Create your agency
welcome.lead: An agency holds your clients, your team and their access. You become its owner.
welcome.name: Agency name
welcome.invited: Were you invited to an agency that already exists? Open the link in the invitation email instead.
shell.switcher.label: Clients and agencies
account.title: Account
account.profile.title: Profile
account.profile.name: Name
account.preferences.title: Language and theme
account.password.title: Password
account.password.lead: Changing your password ends every session, including this one.
account.password.error.current: The current password is not correct.
account.sessions.title: Sessions
account.sessions.lead: Sign out here, or end every session on every device.
account.google.title: Google sign-in
account.google.lead: Link a Google account to sign in without a password.
account.google.linked: Google is now linked to your account.
account.close.title: Close account
account.close.lead: Closing removes your sign-in details and ends your access to every agency. It cannot be undone.
account.close.dialog.title: Close your account?
account.close.dialog.text: Your name and email are removed, every session ends and you leave every agency. This cannot be undone.
account.close.dialog.passwordHint: If you sign in with Google only, leave this empty and sign in with Google again just before you close the account.
account.close.error.reauth: Sign in with Google again, then close the account within ten minutes.
account.close.error.lastOwner: An agency would be left without an owner. Make someone else an owner first.
clients.title: Clients
clients.lead: Each client is a separate workspace. Its data, connections and reports are never mixed with another client's.
clients.add.title: Add a client
clients.name: Client name
clients.nameHint: Shown to everyone who can open this client.
clients.rename.title: Rename {name}
clients.summary.label: Agency summary
clients.summary.attention.row: Accounts that stopped until someone reconnects them.
clients.summary.unconnected.row: No results appear for a client before its first account is connected.
clients.summary.unread: Not every client could be read.
clients.status.reconnectMany: {count, plural, one {# account to reconnect} other {# accounts to reconnect}}
clients.countFiltered: {shown} of {total, plural, one {# client} other {# clients}}
clients.empty.title: No clients yet
clients.empty.manager: Add the first client, then connect its accounts to see its results.
clients.empty.member: You have not been given a client yet. Ask an owner or admin of the agency.
clients.archive.title: Archive {name}?
clients.archive.text: Nobody can open it and its accounts stop syncing until it is restored. Nothing is deleted: its data, connections and access stay as they are.
clients.archived: {name} is archived. It is listed under Archived, where it can be restored.
clients.archived.count: {count, plural, one {# archived client} other {# archived clients}}
clients.active.none: No client is active. Restore an archived client, or add a new one.
connections.title: Connections
connections.lead: The accounts {client} lets Connect read. Connect reads analytics and spend. It never posts, edits or charges.
connections.live.label: Connected accounts
connections.run.reason.rate_limited: The provider asked Connect to slow down.
connections.run.reason.budget_exhausted: Today's allowance for this account is used.
connections.run.reason.unauthorized: The provider no longer accepts this connection.
connections.run.reason.permanent: The provider reported an error that another try will not fix.
connections.allowance.connection_allocat: This account has used its allowance for today.
connections.allowance.provider_quota: The provider's limit for today is reached.
connections.sync.requested: A sync was requested. New data appears here when it finishes.
connections.reconnect.title: Reconnect {provider}
connections.reconnect.lead: You will sign in at the provider again with the same account.
connections.reconnect.manager: Stored data stays available. New data stops until you reconnect the account.
connections.reconnect.member: Stored data stays available. New data stops until an owner or admin reconnects the account.
connections.disconnect.title: Disconnect {name}?
connections.disconnect.text: Connect stops reading this account now and removes the data it stored from it. Reports that use it will show no data. This cannot be undone.
connections.disconnect.understood: I understand that this cannot be undone
connections.disconnecting.until: Its stored data is removed by {date}.
connections.reason.deauthorized: Access was removed at {provider}, so this account is being disconnected
connections.reason.deletion_requested: The account holder asked {provider} to delete their data
connections.reason.authorization_lost: This account was not reconnected in time and is being disconnected
connections.reason.operator_purged: This account is being disconnected by Connect
connections.empty.title: Connect the first account
connections.empty.manager: Results appear after {client} connects an account. Connect reads analytics only and never posts.
connections.empty.member: No account is connected for {client} yet. An owner or admin of the agency can connect one.
connections.past.title: Past connections
connections.past.lead: Accounts that were disconnected. Their stored data is removed.
connections.past.revocation.failed: Data removed. Remove Connect's access in the provider's settings.
connections.connect.title: Connect an account
connections.connect.lead: You will sign in at the provider and allow Connect to read for {client}. Connect never receives the password.
connections.connect.adAccountHint: The number from Meta Ads Manager, with or without “act_”.
connections.connect.adAccountError: Enter the account number: digits only, with or without “act_”.
connections.connect.approval: I hold this account, or act for its holder, and approve the agency and the people it gives access to {client} to read its data as my agents.
connections.connect.approvalError: Tick the box to give this approval before you continue.
connections.complete.title: Back from the provider
connections.complete.next: The first sync is running. Data appears here when it finishes.
connections.complete.nothing: There is no connection to finish here.
connections.error.connection_failed: The connection could not be completed. Try again.
connections.error.connection_cancelled: The connection was cancelled at the provider.
connections.error.connection_denied: This connection was started by another session. Start it again from here.
connections.error.connection_changed: The connection changed while you were at the provider. Check its state and try again.
connections.error.account_mismatch: You signed in with a different account. Reconnect with the account that was connected before.
connections.error.account_already_connec: This account is already connected to this client.
connections.error.account_unavailable: The provider could not give access to this account. Check that it is the right kind of account and that you may manage it.
connections.error.scopes_missing: The provider did not grant everything Connect needs to read. Try again and allow each permission.
connections.error.provider_unavailable: This kind of account cannot be connected on this server yet.
connections.error.agent_approval_require: The approval is needed before this account can be connected.
connections.error.invalid_account: The account number was not accepted. Check it and try again.
connections.error.connection_not_active: This account is no longer active. Reload to see its state.
connections.error.reconnect_not_availabl: This account does not need a reconnect any more.
connections.error.sync_in_progress: Another sync of this account is still running.
connections.error.sync_required: A first sync must finish before more history can be read.
connections.error.sync_failed: The sync could not be requested.
connections.error.access_denied: Only an owner or admin of the agency can do this.
provider.instagram.reads: Account, post, reel and story analytics of a professional account.
provider.youtube.reads: Channel and video analytics of one channel.
provider.meta_ads.reads: Campaigns and daily spend of one ad account.
provider.synthetic.reads: Made-up data for trying Connect. It contacts nobody.
grants.none: The agency has no clients yet. Add a client first.
team.title: Team and access
team.lead: Who can open which client, and who can see money. Access to a client and access to its financial data are granted separately.
team.invite.title: Invite a person
team.invite.emailHint: The invitation can be accepted only by an account with this address.
team.invite.clientsHint: Tick “Financial data” to let them see revenue and spend of that client.
team.invite.error.exists: This person is already a member, or an invitation is still waiting for them.
team.invite.sent: An invitation is on its way to {email}. It can be accepted until {date}.
team.roles.title: What each role can do
team.roles.owner: Everything, including making other owners. There is always at least one.
team.roles.admin: Manages clients, connections, people and keys for every client.
team.roles.analyst: Reads the clients they are granted. Sees revenue and spend only where financial data is granted too.
team.roles.client_viewer: Someone from the client's own team. Reads the clients they are granted and changes nothing.
team.roles.audit: Every change here is written to the audit log.
team.invitations.lead: A person joins the agency by accepting the invitation sent to their email.
team.withdraw.title: Withdraw this invitation?
team.withdraw.text: The link sent to {email} stops working. You can invite them again later.
team.empty.title: No invitations yet
team.empty.text: Invite the people who work with your clients. Each one gets a role and the clients they may open.
team.member.access.title: Access of {name}
team.member.access.managers: Owners and admins open every client and see its financial data.
team.member.pause.title: Pause the access of {name}?
team.member.pause.text: They can no longer open the agency or any of its clients until their access is restored. Their role and client access are kept in the meantime.
team.member.error.lastOwner: An agency must keep at least one active owner. Make someone else an owner first.
team.members.footer: Owners and admins open every client. Analysts and client viewers open only the clients they are given.
keys.title: API keys
keys.lead: Keys let your own systems read a client's data or send events to Connect. A key is shown once, when it is created.
keys.issue.title: Create a key
keys.name: Name
keys.nameHint: Say what uses the key, such as “Reporting sheet”.
keys.kind.read.hint: Reads the data of the chosen clients. It changes nothing.
keys.kind.ingest.hint: Sends events and consent for the chosen clients. It reads nothing.
keys.lifetimeHint: A key stops working when its time ends. 90 days is the longest.
keys.issued.title: Key “{name}” is ready
keys.issued.once: Copy the key now and keep it somewhere safe. It is not shown again.
keys.revoke.title: Revoke “{name}”?
keys.revoke.text: Everything that uses this key stops working at once. This cannot be undone.
keys.footer: Connect keeps only a fingerprint of each key. A lost key cannot be shown again: revoke it and create a new one.
keys.empty.title: No keys yet
keys.empty.text: Create a key when one of your own systems needs to read a client's data or send events.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: The newest {count} changes to the agency, its clients, people and keys, newest first.
audit.someone: someone who is not a member
audit.empty.title: Nothing is recorded yet
audit.empty.text: Changes to the agency appear here as they are made.
audit.footer: {count, plural, one {# change is shown} other {# changes are shown}}. Connect records every change and never edits or removes one.
audit.action.membership.updated: Changed the role or access of {name}
audit.action.grant.updated: Changed what {name} sees of a client
audit.action.grant.revoked: Removed the access of {name} to a client
audit.action.source.secret_rotated: Replaced the secret of a website tracking source
audit.action.deletion.requested: Asked for a person's data to be deleted
audit.action.content.created: Added a piece of content for links
audit.action.content.updated: Changed a piece of content for links
audit.action.domain.challenge_issued: Started the verification of a link domain
audit.action.payment_source.secret_repla: Replaced the secret of a payment source
audit.action.integration.secret_replaced: Replaced the secret of an integration
audit.action.delivery.dismissed: Dismissed a conversion that was not sent
audit.action.revenue.association_detache: Detached a sale from a person
audit.action.identity.unmerged: Undid a merge of two people
audit.action.identity.erasure_resolved: Decided a request to erase a person's data
tracking.title: Website tracking
integrations.title: Integrations
links.title: Links
links.lead: Short links that carry a campaign and a piece of content with them, so a visit can be traced back to the post that sent it.
links.search: Search by address, campaign or content
links.count.active: {shown} of {total, plural, one {# active link} other {# active links}}
links.count.paused: {shown} of {total, plural, one {# paused link} other {# paused links}}
links.count.expired: {shown} of {total, plural, one {# expired link} other {# expired links}}
links.action.copyTarget: Copy the address visitors arrive at
links.pause.title: Pause this link?
links.pause.text: Visitors who open {address} are told that it does not exist until you resume it. Nothing else changes.
links.copied.failed: The browser did not allow copying.
links.expiry.title: When does the link end?
links.empty.title: No links yet
links.empty.text: Create a short link for a post or an ad. Each visit it brings is counted with its campaign and content.
links.empty.textReader: The short links of this client appear here once its managers create them.
links.error.slugTaken: This short address is taken. Choose another path.
links.error.refused: The link was not accepted. Check the destination, the path and the values against the rules beside them.
links.error.settingRefused: This was not accepted. Check the values against the rules beside them.
links.form.title: New link
links.form.subtitle: It leads to a page on one of this client's sites.
links.form.destinationHint: The full address of the page, on one of this client's sites: {sites}.
links.form.destinationHintNone: The full address of the page, on a site this client has approved.
links.form.noSites.title: No destination site yet
links.form.noSites.text: A link can only lead to a site this client has approved. Add the site first.
links.form.domainPending: Works once the domain is verified
links.form.slugHint: 3 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, such as ramadan-reel.
links.form.templateHint: The template's values are added to the address, and the campaign's code becomes utm_id.
links.form.utmHint: Optional. They take the place of the template's values with the same name.
links.form.expiryHint: Optional, in your own time. Leave it empty for a link that does not end.
links.created.title: Link created
links.created.subtitle: Share the short address in the post or the ad.
links.created.text: The link works now. Its address never changes; you can pause it or give it an end.
links.created.targetHint: The destination with its campaign values and the link's own reference, ts_link.
links.rule.slug: Use 3 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or a digit.
links.rule.slugReserved: This word is kept for Connect itself. Choose another path.
links.rule.code: Use up to 64 letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores.
links.rule.contentCode: Use up to 128 letters, digits, dots, colons, hyphens and underscores.
links.rule.destination: Enter a full web address without spaces, a # part or a user name, such as https://shop.example.com/offer.
links.rule.destinationSite: The address must be on one of this client's destination sites.
links.rule.destinationQuery: After ?, write each value as name=value, once per name, with letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores.
links.rule.destinationQueryName: Only UTM values and the names the site keeps may follow ?. Add the name to the site first.
links.rule.expiryPast: Choose a moment in the future.
links.rule.hostname: Enter a public domain name, such as go.example.com.
links.rule.hostnameInternal: This name belongs to a private network. Use a public domain.
links.rule.site: Enter the site's address only, such as https://shop.example.com, without a path.
links.rule.queryName: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, up to 64 for each name.
links.rule.queryNameReserved: UTM names, click identifiers and ts_link are handled by Connect and cannot be kept here.
links.rule.queryNameSensitive: A name that could carry a password, a key or a person's details cannot be kept.
links.campaigns.title: Campaigns
links.campaigns.lead: A campaign groups links. Its code reaches the site as utm_id and never changes.
links.campaigns.codeHint: Letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, such as ramadan-2026. It cannot be changed later.
links.campaigns.label: Name
links.campaigns.error.exists: A campaign with this code already exists.
links.campaigns.empty.title: No campaigns yet
links.campaigns.empty.text: Campaigns let you compare the links that serve one purpose, such as a seasonal offer.
links.content.title: Content
links.content.lead: The posts, reels and videos a link appears in, by the code their platform gives them.
links.content.codeHint: The identifier of the post at its platform. It cannot be changed later.
links.content.label: Name
links.content.labelHint: How your team knows it, such as “Iftar menu carousel”.
links.content.error.exists: Content with this code already exists.
links.content.empty.title: No content yet
links.content.empty.text: Add a post or a video here to see which piece of content each visit came from.
links.templates.title: UTM templates
links.templates.lead: Values that many links share. A link keeps the values it was created with.
links.templates.changeText: Links created from now on use the new values. Links that exist keep theirs.
links.templates.name: Name
links.templates.nameHint: Such as “Instagram, unpaid”. It cannot be changed later.
links.templates.valuesHint: Fill in at least one, with letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores.
links.templates.error.empty: Fill in at least one value.
links.templates.error.exists: A template with this name already exists.
links.templates.empty.title: No templates yet
links.templates.empty.text: A template saves typing the same utm_source and utm_medium on every link.
links.sites.title: Destination sites
links.sites.lead: The sites this client's links may lead to. A link to any other site is refused.
links.sites.originHint: Its address only, with https, such as https://shop.example.com.
links.sites.namesHint: Optional. The names the site needs after ? in its addresses, such as lang or ref, separated by commas.
links.sites.error.exists: This site is already on the list.
links.sites.error.hostConflict: This site is served by Connect or claimed as a link domain, so a link cannot lead to it.
links.sites.off.title: Turn off {site}?
links.sites.off.text: The links that lead to this site stop working until you turn it back on, and no new link can lead to it.
links.sites.empty.title: No destination sites yet
links.sites.empty.text: Add the client's own site before its first link: links lead only to the sites on this list.
links.domains.title: Domains
links.domains.lead: A domain of the client's own for its short links, such as go.example.com. It works once its DNS record is checked.
links.domains.hostnameHint: A name the client controls. Nobody else can use it once it is added.
links.domains.error.hostConflict: This name is used by Connect or by a destination site, so it cannot be a link domain.
links.domains.error.exists: This domain has already been added, here or for another client.
links.domains.error.refused: This domain was not accepted. Check the name.
links.domains.error.unavailable: Domain checks are not available on this server, so the domain cannot be verified here.
links.domains.checked.verified: {host} is verified. Its short links work now.
links.domains.checked.stale: {host} changed while it was checked. Check it again.
links.domains.record.title: DNS record for {host}
links.domains.record.once: Add this record at the domain's DNS provider now. Its value is not shown again, and it is valid until {date}.
links.domains.record.name: {type} record name
links.domains.record.cname: Point {host} with a CNAME record to
links.domains.record.next: When the record is in place, choose Check now in the domain's menu. A new record replaces this one.
links.domains.off.title: Turn off {host}?
links.domains.off.text: Its short links stop working at once. The name stays reserved for this client.
links.domains.empty.title: No domains
links.domains.empty.text: Short links use Connect's own address until the client adds a domain of its own.
links.domains.footer: A check reads the DNS record, the address the domain points to and its certificate. A verification lasts a day at most.
links.domain.failure.ownership_missing: The TXT record was not found. It can take a while to appear after it is added.
links.domain.failure.routing_mismatch: The domain does not point to Connect yet. Check its CNAME record.
links.domain.failure.address_not_allowed: The domain points to an address that cannot be used.
links.domain.failure.tls_invalid: The domain's certificate could not be confirmed.
links.domain.failure.challenge_expired: The record expired before the check. Get a new DNS record.
links.domain.failure.host_conflict: Connect or a destination site already uses this name.
links.domain.failure.verification_unavai: The check could not be completed. Try again later.
links.domain.failure.other: The domain could not be verified. Try again later.
tracking.lead: What the websites and servers of {client} send to Connect, with each visitor's consent, and what Connect did with it.
tracking.leadReader: What Connect received from the websites and servers of {client}, day by day. Its owners and admins set up the tracking.
tracking.error.notConfigured: Event collection is not set up on this server yet.
tracking.kind.browser.hint: The tracker on the client's website records each visitor's consent and then page views, link clicks and forms.
tracking.kind.webhook.hint: The client's own server sends signed events. Its signing secret is shown once.
tracking.sources.title: Sources
tracking.sources.lead: A website source for each site with the tracker, and a webhook source for each server that sends events.
tracking.sources.name: Name
tracking.sources.sitesHint: The exact address of each site that loads the tracker, such as https://shop.example.com, one per line. Up to 10.
tracking.sources.noticeHint: Paste the exact words the site shows when it asks for consent. Only their fingerprint is sent and kept with each consent record.
tracking.sources.digestNone: The fingerprint appears here as you paste the notice.
tracking.sources.error.refused: The source was not accepted. Check the name, the sites and the notice.
tracking.sources.empty.title: Nothing sends events yet
tracking.sources.empty.text: Create a website source for the client's site, then install the tracker with the code Connect gives you.
tracking.install.title: Install the tracker for {name}
tracking.install.public: The public key is not a secret: it only lets the sites of this source send their visitors’ consent and events.
tracking.install.step.files: Copy tracker.js and minimize.js of the tracker {version} to the site's own assets. Connect does not host them.
tracking.install.step.policy: If the site has a Content Security Policy, allow {collector} in its connect-src.
tracking.install.step.consent: Connect the site's consent banner to the tracker's grant, resume, withdraw and erase. Nothing is sent before a visitor agrees.
tracking.install.step.forms: Register each form below before the tracker reads it.
tracking.webhook.title: Webhook of {name}
tracking.webhook.signature: Sign each request with the header {header}: the time in seconds and the HMAC-SHA256 of the time, a dot and the body, with the signing secret.
tracking.secret.title: Signing secret of {name}
tracking.secret.once: Copy the signing secret now and keep it on the server. It is not shown again.
tracking.secret.onceRotated: Copy the new secret now; it is not shown again. The previous secret keeps working for 24 hours, so the server can switch without losing events.
tracking.secret.label: Signing secret
tracking.rotate.title: Replace the signing secret?
tracking.rotate.text: A new secret is shown once. The current one keeps working for 24 hours, then stops.
tracking.off.browser.title: Turn this website source off?
tracking.off.browser.text: Its sites can no longer record consent or send events until you turn it back on. What was received is kept.
tracking.off.webhook.title: Turn this webhook source off?
tracking.off.webhook.text: Its server can no longer send events until you turn it back on. What was received is kept.
tracking.forms.title: Forms
tracking.forms.lead: The forms whose answers the tracker may read, field by field.
tracking.forms.keyHint: The name the page gives this form in its tracker settings, such as lead. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.
tracking.forms.never: Only choices, codes and numbers can be read. Email, phone, names, free text, passwords and payment fields are never read, whatever their name.
tracking.forms.error.refused: The form was not accepted. Check its name and its fields.
tracking.forms.empty.title: No forms registered
tracking.forms.empty.text: Register a form to count its answers, such as the plan a visitor chooses. Without it, the tracker reads no form.
tracking.field.name: Name in the page
tracking.field.nameHint: The name attribute of the control, such as plan.
tracking.field.label: Label
tracking.field.class.option.hint: Only the listed choices are kept.
tracking.field.class.code.hint: A short code such as a coupon or a product reference.
tracking.field.class.quantity.hint: A quantity, such as the number of guests.
tracking.field.optionsHint: One per line or separated by commas, as the page sends them.
tracking.rule.origin: Write each site as its address only, with http or https, such as https://shop.example.com.
tracking.rule.originsMany: A source takes up to 10 sites.
tracking.rule.formKey: Use lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, up to 100.
tracking.rule.fieldName: Use letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, up to 100.
tracking.rule.fieldsNone: A form needs at least one field.
tracking.rule.fieldsMany: A form takes up to 32 fields.
tracking.rule.optionsNone: List the choices of this field.
tracking.rule.optionsLong: Up to 100 choices of up to 100 characters each.
tracking.diagnostics.title: What arrived
tracking.diagnostics.lead: Daily counts of what the collector kept, refused, held back or trimmed. No visitor and no content is shown.
tracking.diagnostics.footer: Counters are kept for 30 days. They hold codes and numbers only.
tracking.reason.unknown_link: Names a link that is not this client's
tracking.reason.unknown_form: A form that is not registered
tracking.reason.unknown_field: A field that is not registered
tracking.reason.occurred_at_out_of_range: Its time is too far from now
tracking.reason.invalid_payload: Its content did not follow the format
tracking.reason.sensitive_query_value: A value that looked like personal data
tracking.erasures.title: Erasure requests
tracking.erasures.lead: Erase a visitor's events and consent records at their request, by their token or by one of their event identifiers.
tracking.erasures.objected: With an objection to further use
tracking.erasures.empty.title: No erasure requests
tracking.erasures.empty.text: When a visitor asks to be forgotten, erase them here or let the tracker do it from the site.
tracking.erase.title: Erase a visitor?
tracking.erase.text: This deletes the visitor's events, consent records and subject at once, for this client. It cannot be undone.
tracking.erase.tokenHint: It starts with sbj_. The visitor’s browser holds it, or your server received it with their consent.
tracking.erase.eventHint: The identifier of any event of the visitor, such as 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004.
tracking.erase.objected: The visitor also objects to any further use of their data
tracking.erase.error.token: A visitor token is sbj_ followed by 43 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.
tracking.erase.error.unknown: No visitor of this client has this token or event.
tracking.erase.error.refused: The request was not accepted. Check the token or the identifier.
tracking.erase.done: The visitor was erased. Their token and events are refused from now on.
tracking.erase.recorded: The request was recorded and is being carried out.
tracking.erasure.by.agency_admin: An owner or admin of the agency

legal.pending: This text has not been published yet.
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

error.network: Connect could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
error.rate_limitedSeconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
error.validation_failed: Some details were not accepted. Check the form and try again.
error.session_check: This page is out of date. Reload it and try again.
error.access_denied: You do not have access to this.
error.state_conflict: This could not be completed because something changed. Reload and try again.
error.request_too_large: That is too much for one request.
error.temporarily_unavailable: Connect is busy for a moment. Try again shortly.
error.plan_limit_reached: This goes beyond what the agency's plan allows.
